title: UNIVERSAL GARMENT SPATIAL 3D — Shorewake spatial-relation engine (offline capability spec)
purpose: Quantified, pose-aware authority for the wardrobe clipping/intersection audit (Nikki doctrine §6 -> HDA_CH_WardrobeIntersectionAudit) without runtime geometric intersection solving. Precomputes expensive garment/body relationships offline so the dress 'precomputes rather than simulates'.

input_stack.body: SK_ShorewakeDress_Melusina465.fbx (retargeted) — binary Kaydara FBX, 22.35 MB, 466 Take records (pose samples)
input_stack.garment_stack: 48 Shorewake panels (dress_materials_manifest.json) consolidated to 10 dead-silhouette garment layers
input_stack.poses: 466 animation Takes from the retargeted FBX + authored QA pose set (T-pose, A-pose, seated, hem-fold, run stride, skirt-peak)

outputs.penetration_heatmap: per-vertex signed penetration depth of each garment layer against the body surface (unsigned distance inside body = negative); latent VDB field + per-layer extraction
outputs.body_hide_groups: per garment region, the body sub-mesh point groups to hide (Nikki hide-mask doctrine: inner surfaces culled under outer garment)
outputs.problem_frames: per-pose subset flagged when min-separation breaches a per-layer clearance threshold
outputs.min_separation_field: distance field of min distance between adjacent garment layers and between garment & body (resolve sky/depth-sort)
outputs.layer_ordering: depth-sort order of the 10 garment materials for any view direction (translucency/OIT-aware priority)
outputs.corrective_targets: candidate corrective morph target clusters for recurring intersections (pose-space correction candidates)

structured_classifications.desc: one clothing-fitted body proxy + one offset skin field; all 10 garment layers read the same field so penetration is comparable across outfits
body hide groups are computed once per garment on the shared body-mesh and reused across 466 poses (pose-invariant regions cached, pose-adaptive residual per frame)

core_algorithms.desc: build a dense SDF (VDBCreateFromVolume / iso-offset) of the body proxy; evaluate each garment vertex + sample shell for signed distance; penetration = signed_dist < 0. cliff/clip near-zero epsilon. Returns per-vertex penetration scalar + latent field for reuse.
core_algorithms.evidence: hython present: C:/Program Files/Side Effects Software/Houdini 22.0.368/bin/hython.exe; numpy 2.4.6 present

core_algorithms.prescribed_tool: python3 + numpy + trimesh/pyvista over the retargeted FBX
core_algorithms.desc: load geometry from the retargeted FBX, KDTree (scipy.cKDTree) of body verts; nearest-point distance per garment vertex; sign by normal.dot(p_garment - p_body_near) to derive inward/outward. Independent cross-check of A1; runs headless in venv python.
prescribed Monolith mesh_query actions map to the HDA outputs; NOT run headless in this spec — the mesh_query surface stays reserved for an editor-gated bake; offline classes are A1/A2 only.
core_algorithms.note: stays headless; requirement notes mesh_query may not be run here

core_algorithms.desc: compute per-layer mean radius and reveal direction from body spine; produce static material draw-order + per-view depth-sort using the min-separation field so translucency (M_Collar alpha, M_Skirt_Full sheen) sorts correctly. Respects Nikki OIT caution + layer priority trick; no engine-fork.
core_algorithms.evidence: 10-layer grid from cymatic garment manifest seed 20260902

core_algorithms.desc: over problem frames, cluster per-vertex displacement vectors (k-means via numpy) into recurring intersection regions; each cluster yields one corrective-morph target (target mesh edits toward the precomputed 'author' of the region), feeding Control Rig / pose-space correction. Mirrors Nikki correctives.

mapping.source: penetration_heatmap (volume + nodal signature per garment Chladni mode)
mapping.semantic: how strongly the garment stands / sings against the body at a point
how much the garment is 'pulling' / compressing at a location; high tension = low separation near recurring intersection
garment-to-body contact regions (where hide masks apply)

risk_ranking.evidence: largest panel (47->dressedit53/54: 45884/68419 polys) + Tier B Chaos self-intersection on movement; multilayered hem vol
inner skin-cling slip; smallest body offset among skirt stack
skin-tight torso panels (25k poly region, smallest body clearance)
arm region compression during bend/stride poses
